inlines.v: STAMMER, verb intransitive Literally, to stop in uttering syllables or words; to stutter; to hesitate or falter in speaking; and hence, to speak with stops and difficulty. Demosthenes is said to have stammered in speaking, and to have overcome the difficulty by persevering efforts. STAMMER, verb transitive To utter or pronounce with hesitation or imperfectly.
